title: Simulation in discrete choice models evaluation: SDCM, a simulation tool for performance evaluation of DCMs
abstract: arXiv:2407.17014v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrete choice models are widely used in economics, transportation, and marketing to explain and predict how decision makers choose among a finite set of alternatives. The resulting choices depend on the socioeconomic characteristics of the decision makers, the attributes of the alternatives, and the conditions under which the decision is made. Because these factors interact in complex ways, and because real experiments raise confidentiality concerns, take time, and are costly, controlled experimentation with real respondents is often impractical. Simulation offers an alternative in which the data-generating process, and hence the true parameters, are known. This paper connects discrete choice modeling, experimental design, and simulation. translated_title: 离散选择模型评估中的仿真：SDCM——一种用于离散选择模型性能评估的仿真工具
translated_abstract: 离散选择模型被广泛应用于经济学、交通和市场营销领域，用于解释和预测决策者如何在有限的备选方案集合中进行选择。选择结果取决于决策者的社会经济特征、备选方案的属性以及决策所处的条件。由于这些因素以复杂的方式相互作用，且真实实验存在保密性问题、耗时且成本高昂，因此使用真实受访者进行受控实验往往并不现实。仿真提供了一种替代方案，其中数据生成过程乃至真实参数都是已知的。本文将离散选择建模、实验设计和仿真这三个领域联系起来。我们以统一的符号体系回顾了这三个领域，并阐述了仿真方法所依赖的相关结论。随后，我们形式化了一个仿真工具，该工具将实验设计与行为……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了名为SDCM的仿真工具，将实验设计与已知的数据生成过程相结合，克服了真实受访者实验中保密性差、耗时且成本高的局限，实现了对离散选择模型性能的受控评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SDCM, a simulation tool that combines experimental design with a known data-generating process to enable controlled performance evaluation of discrete choice models, overcoming the confidentiality, time, and cost limitations of experiments with real respondents.
